Classical uncomplemented-subspace and uniform-convexity theorems complete the existence proof; all cases are covered analytically.

value.rationale: The exact iff isolates the extension-theoretic obstruction for a full natural class of triangular operators. It converts the previously established Banach-versus-Hilbert separation into a sharp geometry boundary: failure persists even in separable uniformly convex/superreflexive spaces. The result is not just a numerical variant, and the splitting criterion is reusable for further generalized Kato investigations.
